title: PPO end-of-run checkpoint (ppo_final_*) is degenerate; ppo_best_* is the correct one
severity: defect (training artifact); NOT user-facing (already refused downstream)
method: First-party eval using the exact benchmark methodology (MaskablePPO + saved VecNormalize obs stats + 47-dim per-dimension action mask; grader score env.grade()['score'] at episode end). 30 fixed seeds on easy_typhoon_response, deterministic predict.

ppo_final_easy.zip.verdict: DEGENERATE: policy has collapsed to a single dominant action type (type 6 in 432/600 steps); grade ~0.32 is near the do-nothing floor.

ppo_best_easy/best_model.zip.verdict: HEALTHY: diverse action selection, grade ~0.68. This is the EvalCallback-selected best checkpoint and the one that must be used.

evidence_trail.final_saved_at: rl/train_ppo.py:249 (ppo_final_{task}.zip written at end of training, no degeneracy guard)
evidence_trail.downstream_consumer_handled: benchmark/run_full_benchmark.py:236 loads ppo_best_{tk}/best_model.zip and explicitly refuses ppo_final (documented run_full_benchmark.py:218-220: 'end-of-run ppo_final_* checkpoints are near-degenerate ... using them would MIS-report PPO downward, so we do not').
evidence_trail.not_served_elsewhere: server/ does not load either PPO checkpoint for /predict; supplymind/phoenix/counterfactual_twin/twin.py loads the v3 gethsemane checkpoints (versions/v3_arcadia/checkpoints/gethsemane/ppo_*.zip), NOT ppo_final; supplymind/phoenix/arena baseline 'MaskablePPO-v3' derives from R6_EUCLIDIAN.json (the good v3 policy), NOT ppo_final.

remaining_action.owner: rl/ maintainer (NOT this integrity-sweep agent's scope)
remaining_action.recommendation: In rl/train_ppo.py, at the ppo_final save site (:249), emit a loud logged warning that the end-of-run checkpoint may be degenerate and that ppo_best_{task} is the checkpoint to load/serve; or refuse to save ppo_final when its eval grade is materially below the best checkpoint. This receipt records the defect so it cannot silently return.
